caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL.) of two models — Transformer (dashed red line) and MoHD (solid blue line with square markers) — as a function of the ratio of shared sub-dimensions to total sub-dimensions, ranging from 0/4 to 4/4. The x-axis, labeled “Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims,” is categorical, with five discrete points: 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL.,” is linear and spans from 10.0 to 12.5, with major tick marks at 10.0, 10.5, 11.0, 11.5, 12.0, and 12.5. The Transformer model’s performance remains nearly constant across all ratios, with Eval PPL. hovering slightly above 11.6 (approximately 11.65 at 0/4 and 4/4). In contrast, the MoHD model exhibits a U-shaped trend: starting at 11.1 at 0/4, decreasing to a minimum of approximately 10.3 at 3/4, then rising to 10.8 at 4/4. A light blue shaded region under the MoHD line visually emphasizes its performance trajectory. The legend in the upper right identifies the two models with their respective line styles and colors.
